evidence.note: קַיִן names the child in וַתֵּלֶד אֶת קַיִן, “she bore Cain.” Eve's following words קָנִיתִי אִישׁ supply the wordplay.

name: קַיִן
note: The name's historical derivation remains uncertain. The verse supplies a wordplay with קָנִיתִי, but that does not establish an etymological root.
summary: Eve bears a son named Cain. Her words קָנִיתִי אִישׁ, “I have acquired a man,” associate his name with acquiring.
